generalization: Current domain only; other domains require new trials

lessons.trigger: A component improvement is proposed for more than one task domain
lessons.bottleneck: Checker launch counts can miss model, retrieval, reporting and recovery costs
lessons.intervention: Freeze full-task quality, native token accounting and per-domain elapsed/token guards; test transfer plus the old capability
lessons.observed_result: All Probe deliverables passed. General's sum of task token medians improved 10.4%, but scientific time grew 23.6%; domain scientific tokens grew about 25%. Neither was eligible.
lessons.scope: Two observed task domains, three repetitions each; not evidence about all possible general or domain proposals
lessons.invalid_when: Task value, acceptance criteria, inputs, model or resource accounting differ
lessons.next_probe: Use complete deliverable cost and an existing successful task as regression when proposing the next strategy change.

lessons.trigger: An Agent repeatedly guesses that a shared library root contains SKILL.md or workspace-root scripts
lessons.bottleneck: Wrong path lookups and redundant context reads
lessons.intervention: Use an indexed, hash-checked context loader, assigned entry path and explicit typed tool interfaces; retain independent calculation and output checks
lessons.scope: The tested release and GISTEMP portfolio; component causality is not isolated, and the reader currently routes these indexed profile types
lessons.invalid_when: Library schema, task inputs, profile types, tool paths or source formats change
lessons.next_probe: Read the selected profile and this card in a genuinely new task; require real artifacts before claiming post-adoption transfer.

lessons.trigger: Native turn completion is missing at the time limit, or two host clocks disagree
lessons.bottleneck: Partial artifacts and uncertain measurements can be mislabeled as successful efficient runs
lessons.intervention: Keep timeout/cancellation evidence, create one separately frozen repair round for every strategy, and mark conflicting time evidence unknown
lessons.observed_result: The first 300-second climate turn had no final usage. The repaired round used 600 seconds for all arms. General release UTC and monotonic time differed by about 503 seconds; its guard remained unknown.
lessons.scope: Observed local execution and accounting; no diagnosis of host sleep or clock-change cause
lessons.invalid_when: An independent host receipt later resolves the discrepancy; append evidence rather than rewriting original readings
lessons.next_probe: Capture UTC, monotonic timing and native completion in later task receipts; budget delivery and termination, not computation alone.

lessons.trigger: A scientific input uses abbreviated decimal notation or a float result is compared to an exact decimal literal
lessons.bottleneck: Generated validation rejects valid data or harmless floating-point representation
lessons.intervention: Accept the documented numeric syntax and check finite parsed values; compare independent arithmetic using a justified tolerance. Preserve valid computation when only the local readback assertion needs repair.
lessons.observed_result: The Agent corrected rejection of -.17 before the adapter ran, then corrected an exact-equality readback assertion without rerunning valid computation. The unchanged independent evaluator passed; 408.173 seconds and 479041 tokens remain measured.
lessons.scope: Observed local recovery on NASA annual values; not a newly tested global parsing rule or proof every recovery branch works
lessons.invalid_when: A domain requires exact rational/decimal identities, different precision, missing codes or syntax
lessons.next_probe: Use these actual counterexamples when generating future numeric preflight checks; test the revised validation on new source data rather than relaxing the external evaluator.

evidence_scope: Historical lessons; see the bundled trial reports. Raw source traces are not distributed and imported profiles need validation in their new host.
